plan: To preserve capital, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to cure the concentration breach and SPY to 15% for reduced broad index exposure.
Add XOM at 5% as a top-quality long setup from the scanner.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces overall portfolio risk and potential drawdowns. Expect lower volatility and more stable returns.

plan: For risk-first growth, trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to small allocations.
Reduce QQQI to 20% to cure the concentration breach and SPY to 20% for balanced broad index exposure.
Add XOM at 5% as a top-quality long setup from the scanner.
This plan blends broad index, quality tech, and a small amount of leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall concentration and leverage, aiming for a more stable growth trajectory. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

plan: For aggressive growth, increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to press what is working.
Trim QQQI to 15% to cure the concentration breach and SPY to 15% to free up capital.
Add XOM at 5% as a top-quality long setup from the scanner.
This plan concentrates in high-scoring setups and uses leverage for stretch growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk due to higher leverage and concentration. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.

plan: To park cash for yield, sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.
Sell high-beta single names like CRWD and SNOW to near zero.
Add QQQI to 30% to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions. It significantly reduces growth potential and volatility, aiming for cash-like income. Note that distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
